name: Entitlements
description: Retrieves the features available to a company, identified by the company's realmID. The available features are determined by the type of company established during QuickBooks Online setup, and represent a superset of those enabled for the company by preferences and for a user by permissions.

operations.name: Read entitlements

pathParams.name: realmID
pathParams.description: The company ID (realmID) identifying the QuickBooks Online company whose entitlements are retrieved.

operations.note: This resource does not accept an application/json Accept header. Use application/xml as the Accept header; the response is returned as XML (EntitlementsResponse). The path uses the /entitlements/v3/<realmID> form rather than the standard /v3/company/<realmID>/... form.
